text:
Samir: Pushed a first-pass PRD + rollout checklist for the tenant pinning feature and the v2.1 model rollout. Asking for quick review on scope tradeoffs, acceptance criteria, and the canary experiment design. doc: https://redwood.atlassian.org/browse/PRD-1234

Alex: skimmed — looks reasonable. couple Qs: do we need per-tenant hard pinning or soft pinning (routing preference)? soft is simpler but harder to guarantee isolation.

Samir: good point. proposal currently: soft pinning by default + optional hard pin in Dedicated/Private only. goal: minimize infra changes for hosted while still giving entitlements.

Mira: from SRE perspective we should require a fallback route that can be enabled automatically if latency or error rate spikes. need concrete thresholds.

Jordan: agree. suggested thresholds in doc page section 3.2: >2x baseline 95p latency OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m triggers fallback. that can be tuned.

Sana: product-design asks to add UX acceptance criteria: the console must clearly show which tenants are pinned and whether it's hard or soft. include an undo/rollforward control.

Kevin: DevEx note — we should ship a debug endpoint `GET /admin/pinning/status` for support and add a telemetry tag `pin_mode:[soft|hard|none]` to traces.

Samir: I'll add those. also need experiment matrix for canary: suggested plan in PRD: 1) 5% of traffic for 12h, monitor latency & quality evals; 2) 25% for 24h; 3) gradual to 100% with daily checkpoints.

Alex: for quality checks we should run the offline eval set + a small live compare on a sampled prompt set (1k requests/day). require generation similarity > 95% of baseline on our eval metrics.

Mira: add operational acceptance: SLOs must remain within 10% of baseline for p50/p95 and p99 not exceed an absolute cap (p99 < 500ms for short prompts). if violations occur, auto-fallback to previous model.

Jordan: infra checklist: quantization profile for v2.1 tested on both T4 and A100 pools, memory regression checked, KV cache behavior validated. also verify autoscale ramps during canary.

Samir: edge cases I flagged in doc: tenant with pin + cached prefix mismatch, pinned tenant that uses streaming protocols, and model rollback while in mid-stream. need explicit handling for each.

Alex: for streaming rollback: rule should be "finish in-flight streams on old model, no new streams routed to it". low complexity and consistent behavior.

Mira: for cached prefixes, add a cache-invalidation step as part of rollout playbook: `invalidate-prefix --tenant <id> --grace 60s` and document potential transient latency.

Kevin: support playbook draft: include exact rollback commands, steps to flip routing, and SL message templates. also add a quick `curl` snippet for emergency rollback.

Samir: adding sample rollback snippet now:
```
# emergency rollback to v2.0
POST /admin/route/fallback
{ "target_model": "v2.0", "mode": "force", "reason": "auto-triggered" }
```

Sana: also include communication criteria: if rollback happens we notify affected tenants and internal SRE oncall, and create an incident if >5 tenants impacted or >1% traffic diverted.

Jordan: experiment metrics to capture: latency p50/p95/p99, token cost per request, error rate, model-quality delta (eval-set similarity), and routing churn. need dashboards prepped before canary.

Mira: can we add a smoke test suite that runs post-deploy automatically and validates 10 synthetic prompts for each tenant type? pass/fail gates before canary ramp.

Samir: yes — I'll add smoke tests + a gating job. action items: Samir update PRD (scope + UX + playbook) ; Alex to confirm streaming rollback implementation; Mira to add SRE thresholds and automation for fallback; Jordan to validate infra test matrix; Kevin to author support playbook and debug endpoints.

Alex: ETA for implementation work? aiming for a beta rollout in 3 weeks. I'll confirm blockers by EOD.

Mira: SRE will need 1 week to automate fallback and smoke tests.

Kevin: I'll draft the support playbook today.

Samir: thanks all — ping me on thread if you need changes to acceptance criteria. planning a quick sync on Thursday 10:30 to sign off on canary gates. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Reminder scheduled meeting created: "v2.1 rollout signoff" Thu 10:30 — invites sent to participants.
